messages:
Maya (CSM): Starting Veloria onboarding thread. Quick intro + checklist for the first 30 days: API integration, SSO, basic performance bench (p95 goal < 300ms), relevance eval, enablement recording, and weekly feedback capture. Who are the owners on your side?
Priya (Veloria PM): Hey Maya Priya here. I'll own product acceptance and metrics. Marco will handle infra. Key success criteria: 90% pass on our intents verification set and search NDCG uplift >= 0.08.
Marco (Veloria Infra): Marco Infra lead. Our OIDC is at https://sso.veloria.internal/. We need Redwood allowlist IPs and a short maintenance window for final cutover.
Jun (Solutions Eng): Jun here. I'll lead the connector and tests. Proposed plan: week 1 connector + SSO, week 2 end-to-end smoke + bench, week 3 relevance tuning + enablement. Will need prompt set and a small labeled eval by day 10.
Maya (CSM): Good cadence. I'll schedule three workshops: tech deep-dive, prompts lab, and enablement for support. Proposed times next Wed/Thu. Also setting up a weekly Typeform for pilot feedback (short 5 q).
OnboardBot: sandbox deployment created: veloria-pilot-sbx v2024-03-01 at 1735554500
Jun (Solutions Eng): Received deploy. Asking: enable prefix/KV cache for bench? My recommendation: off during tuning (so results reflect raw model). We can flip on after acceptance checks.
Priya (Veloria PM): Agree to caching OFF initially. Also request recording of enablement and upload to our internal docs.
Maya (CSM): Action items logged: Maya -> send allowlist + Typeform link; Jun -> provide curl examples and sandbox creds; Priya -> share labeled eval set and product SLAs; Marco -> confirm OIDC metadata + available maintenance windows. Renewal flag: if engagement metrics (active API calls) < 25% of pilot target by day 21, escalate to AM for QBR review.
Jun (Solutions Eng): I'll post a quick curl example and test vector here:
```
curl -X POST https://sbx.api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \\\\n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VELORIA_SBX_KEY" \\\\n  -d '{"input":"Summarize invoice #123 for user"}'
```
Marco (Veloria Infra): We'll open egress to 
- 34.82.12.10/32
- 34.82.12.11/32
Whitelist windows: Tue 03/05 02:00-03:00 UTC or Thu 03/07 01:00-04:00 UTC.
Maya (CSM): Thanks Marco I'll circulate allowlist + pick the Tue window. Also creating shared doc with acceptance criteria and a one-line daily stand note in this thread.
Priya (Veloria PM): One more ask: can Redwood enable per-route cost tags in logs so we can map spend to features during pilot?
Jun (Solutions Eng): Yes, can add route metadata. I'll add an example log line to the shared doc.
Maya (CSM): Great. Next steps: calendar invites + Typeform + shared acceptance doc by EOD. Will check in next Tue for bench results. :thumbsup:
